name: Veo
summary: Google DeepMind's video generation model with native audio.
description: Veo is Google DeepMind's video model (currently Veo 3.1) that generates cinematic clips with synchronized audio from text and image prompts. It is available inside Google products such as Gemini and Flow and to developers via the Gemini API. On the Gemini API it is paid-tier only (not available on the free tier), from $0.05 per second for Veo 3.1 Lite at 720p; Google notes the Veo 3.1 preview endpoints shut down on Oct 22, 2026 in favour of Gemini Omni Flash.
